grain_rationale: row_count is 13014 with duplicate_row_rate 0.0; airport_code has only 3 distinct values and observed_hour_utc has 4341 distinct values, and the combination of the two nearly spans the full row_count, showing each row is a distinct airport-hour weather reading rather than a pre-aggregated rollup. With no duplicate rows, the derived composite identity (airport_code, observed_hour_utc) absorbs the grain exactly, so this is declared transaction grain with no aggregation required.

fields.name: airport_code
fields.description: Three-letter code (EWR, JFK, LGA per the 3 distinct_values) identifying which NYC-area airport the weather reading pertains to; null_rate is 0.0.

fields.name: observed_hour_utc
fields.description: Hourly UTC timestamp of the observation, with 4341 distinct values ranging 2013-01-01T06:00:00 to 2013-07-01T03:00:00 and samples falling exactly on the hour, so it resolves to hour granularity; null_rate is 0.0.

fields.name: observed_date_local
fields.description: Local calendar date of the observation (181 distinct values spanning 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30), a derived local-date label accompanying the UTC timestamp; null_rate is 0.0.

fields.name: observed_hour_local
fields.description: Local hour-of-day (0-23, 24 distinct values) labeling when the observation occurred in local time; it is a categorical time label, not a summable quantity, and null_rate is 0.0.

fields.name: temp_f
fields.description: Air temperature in Fahrenheit ranging 10.94 to 93.92 across 130 distinct values, a continuous measured quantity compared and averaged across readings; null_rate is 0.0.

fields.name: dewpoint_f
fields.description: Dew point temperature in Fahrenheit ranging -9.94 to 73.94 across 119 distinct values, a continuous measured quantity; null_rate is 0.0.

fields.name: humidity_pct
fields.description: Relative humidity percentage ranging 12.74 to 100.0 across 2178 distinct values, a continuous measured quantity; null_rate is 0.0.

fields.name: wind_dir_degrees
fields.description: Wind direction in compass degrees (0 to 360, 37 distinct values) labeling the direction the wind blows from rather than a summable quantity; null_rate is 0.016828, so the field is nullable.

fields.name: wind_speed_mph
fields.description: Wind speed in mph ranging 0.0 to 1048.36058 across 36 distinct values, a measured quantity; null_rate is 0.000154, so the field is nullable for a small fraction of rows.

fields.name: wind_gust_mph
fields.description: Wind gust speed in mph ranging 16.11092 to 62.14212 across 35 distinct values, a measured quantity; null_rate is 0.745505, suggesting gusts are only recorded when they occur, so the field is nullable.

fields.name: precip_inches
fields.description: Precipitation in inches ranging 0.0 to 1.06 across 50 distinct values, a measured quantity summed or averaged across readings; null_rate is 0.0.

fields.name: pressure_mb
fields.description: Barometric pressure in millibars ranging 983.8 to 1038.4 across 430 distinct values, a measured quantity; null_rate is 0.114953, so the field is nullable.

fields.name: visibility_miles
fields.description: Visibility in miles ranging 0.0 to 10.0 across 20 distinct capped values, a measured quantity compared across readings; null_rate is 0.0.

fields.name: airport_name
fields.description: Full airport name (John F. Kennedy International Airport, LaGuardia Airport, Newark Liberty International Airport), 3 distinct values aligned with airport_code; null_rate is 0.0.

fields.name: airport_municipality
fields.description: Municipality where the airport is located (New York, Newark), 2 distinct values, a descriptive airport attribute; null_rate is 0.0.

fields.name: airport_elevation_ft
fields.description: Airport elevation in feet (13, 18, or 21 per the 3 distinct_values), a fixed attribute of the airport rather than a quantity that varies by observation; null_rate is 0.0.

fields.name: airport_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Length of the airport's longest runway in feet (7002, 11000, or 14511 per the 3 distinct_values), a fixed airport attribute; null_rate is 0.0.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Capture timestamp with only 3 distinct values all on 2026-09-02, recording when the row was captured by the pipeline rather than when the weather occurred; null_rate is 0.0.

category_description: Each row represents one hourly weather observation recorded at one of the three NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA per airport_code's 3 distinct_values), carrying temperature, dewpoint, humidity, wind, precipitation, pressure, and visibility readings alongside static airport reference attributes.
purpose: This mapping declares how the silver.silver_airport_weather table enters the gold unified event star as the airport_weather_observations fact category, fixing its time column, grain, and field roles so the deterministic modeling engine that consumes mapping contracts can generate the corresponding gold fact and dimension models.
usage: The deterministic modeling engine reads this mapping contract to generate the gold airport_weather_observations fact; the proposal is rendered into an ODCS mapping contract draft, validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, linted, and reviewed and edited by a human before approval, with no model execution occurring from this proposal itself.
limitations: This mapping does not filter or interpret the high null rates on wind_gust_mph (0.745505), pressure_mb (0.114953), or wind_dir_degrees (0.016828); it leaves exclusion or imputation of those nulls to downstream consumers, and it does not resolve the relationship between captured_at's pipeline-capture semantics and the observed_hour_utc event time beyond citing both as profiled.
